source: results/silicon_sc36/ (lead_silicon, commit 26a943e): 17-point measured workload regression + mincore page-cache scan + collector run
headline: COMPUTE TERM RESOLVED to the 410 GB/s bin (24.1 ms): the earlier 'compute 18.1 fits best' was an artifact of synth-trace miss overstatement (~15%). With the measured real miss count, 24.1 reproduces the anchor exactly.

measured_regression.ms_per_token: 39.2 +/- 8.4 + 0.2883 +/- 0.0534 ms/MB x disk_MB/token (r2 0.66, n=17; recomputed from points: 39.25 / 0.2883)
measured_regression.agreement_pct: within 2.8% — the serial model's miss-cost constant (0.52 io + 0.30 install) is now MEASURED-confirmed at the operating point
measured_regression.prompt_variance: 76-98 ms/token (10.2-13.1 tok/s) across prompts; collect_silicon_run's prompt alone hit 13.9/15.3 — the 13.0 anchor is a property of the prompt as much as the box

real_miss_count.derivation: 140.5 MB/tok / 2.765 MB — valid because the mincore scan REJECTS page-cache absorption (only 2.29 of 71.6 GB expert tables in UBC; 14 slabs/layer)
real_miss_count.implication: synth traces overstate misses ~15% at cap143 -> every synth-based serial prediction is ~0.8-1.1 tps CONSERVATIVE; real routing is more cache-friendly than synth

regression_intercept_check.verdict: weak independent corroboration of 24.1; 18.1 is >1 SE below the measured intercept

compute_term_resolution.physics: M4 Max 36 GB IS the 410 GB/s DRAM bin — the resolved value is also the physically correct one
compute_term_resolution.consequence_for_48GB: 48 GB M4 Max is the 546 GB/s bin -> compute 18.1 stands THERE; Test D (cap224: 17.4 vs 15.8) is unchanged and remains the silicon check for THAT box

test_c_status.collector_run_256x2: chunks carry ~3 tokens (86 chunks / 256 tokens); gaps are CHUNK gaps — coalesced input, INADMISSIBLE per Amendment 1 provenance requirements (and T4's detect_coalescing guard). No S-vs-Q readout from this run; need server-side token timestamps or verified unbuffered delivery.

remaining_caveats: single residency (0.28) — slope/intercept untested at other caps
synth overstatement measured only at cap143
Test D still needed for the 48GB bin

pipelining_bound_note: lead's overlap bound max(fixed, miss-term) = max(39, ~40) -> ~25 tok/s @cap143 (SIM upper bound, consistent with T8's earlier oracle cap)
